Results.ReviewText:
Bought the Spirit II 210 as a replacement for a 7 year old version of another brand. Assembly was a breeze, one hint though, only finger tighten the screws until the firebox is installed. Then go back and fully tighten, it will result in easier assembly, and a more solid frame as well, all good things.
 Now for the real test, the cooking, after the 20 minute "burn off" procedure, I sprayed the grill down with grill spray and refired the grill to slow cook some chicken thighs. Indirect heat, 400° one hour later, removev food and turned back to high direct heat, just for grill marks and BBQ sauce app. In a word WOW!! Chicken was tender, and flavorful. Day 2 found me grilling burgers. Great grill marks and searing, burgers were done quickly, and as burgers go, the flavor was outstanding, and the burgers were juicy. I will recommend to all my friends.
Well done WEBER!!

Results.ReviewText: I currently own and use very frequently 1 Weber kettle grill and the small WSM, I decided that I could use this grill for my weekday cooks.  It's much easier to fire up a gas grill for hamburgers and hot dogs than charcoal.  I have to say this grill is impressive.  It went together very easy, it heats up quick and gets hot. 10 year warranty on top of it all.    But seriously,  only 2 wheels!  Not a show stopper but 4 wheels would have been better for moving it.  The red color is fantastic.  Thank you Weber for another fantastic grill that I am happy to add to my Weber family!

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
